title: Verificar en runtime read-only el probe acotado de study-transcribe-v1
mission: Using only non-sensitive read-only evidence, determine whether the candidate GET ?selftest=probe contract is actually served. First compare the current served function version/digest or route behavior against the candidate source. If the probe is served, execute one bounded GET and record structured phase codes/timings without transcript content. If it is not served, return the exact DEPLOYMENT_REQUIRED authority boundary and do not deploy or mutate Supabase.
definition_of_done: Current served function identity/version is checked without mutating the function or database.
If ?selftest=probe is served, one bounded read-only GET records HTTP status plus non-sensitive phase/result metadata; full_e2e_pass remains false unless the endpoint itself truthfully proves it.
If the candidate is not served, the return names exact candidate source refs and the deployment authority boundary instead of retrying the old heavy ?selftest=1 path.
No audio, transcript, provisional text, session id, room token, credential, database row, Current, Served, Catalog or Human Accepted state is written.
